tagline: STIHL equipment and honest service in Otorohanga
heroSubheading: We stock, service and repair STIHL equipment for local farmers and tradespeople.
aboutHtml:
We're Darren Lupton and Matthew Scott, and we run a STIHL shop here in Otorohanga. We stock the full range of STIHL outdoor power equipment for the work you need to do, from chainsaws and trimmers to blowers and hedgetrimmers.

Beyond selling equipment, we service and repair STIHL machines in our workshop, keep replacement parts on hand, and give honest advice on what will suit your job. Locals choose us because we know what works here in the North, and we back every sale.

Come in and talk to us. We're open Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, and Saturday mornings until noon.
servicesIntro: We service and repair STIHL equipment from our workshop, keeping your machines ready for work.
